body:
This was my first time ever trying this paxil shit, and I knew I was gettin the shroomz a few days in advance so I took 6 20mg pills a day prior to the consumption.The next day I went to work and everyone was telling me pupils were  fucked, there was no colour in my eyes, just black. But the thing was I hadnt taken the mushrooms yet, so I'm guessing it was from the paxil. I picked up some bud and went home, I had nothing to do so I decided it take the mushrooms at about 8:10.  I smoked some bowls at around 8:30, 20 minutes later, and I was already starting to feel the shrooms. Now, I've done mushrooms a few times in the past, and I dont know if it was the paxil, but I had the best trip I ever had in my life! Wen I was watching t.v. the walls were coming in on me too much tho, so I had to get out of my room, I started feeling really trapped in my room. This was about 50 minutes after I ate the mushies and I wasnt even at my peak and I was hallucinating like crazy.
I listend to some music for a while and smoked some more weed then I went up stairs and I came across my dog. I began petting her when I started feeling this weird vibe. I felt like I became one with my dog, and she was feeling the same feeling I was, and tripping with me, she was almost letting me aware of this. I looked down at my arms, and the hair on my arms were all standing up, as was my dogs. I would put my life on it, I saw evryone of my dogs hair like rising, just like when you touch those electric metal balls. When I stared at this longer evrything began to swirl. Its so hard to describe. And I just felt really connected with my dog and made me feel like all animals have this other feeling and senses which I think u can feel when u take pyschedelics, well I did anyone.
